title: HM Land Registry Price Paid Data
description: Every residential property sale in England and Wales: price, date, full address, property type, new build flag and tenure.
notes: Headerless CSV. district is the local authority in upper case, e.g. 'READING', 'COVENTRY'. property_type: D detached, S semi-detached, T terraced, F flat/maisonette, O other (includes commercial). new_build: Y/N. tenure: F freehold, L leasehold. Filter to one district to keep it small.
examples: How have flat prices in Reading changed since 2023?
Will the flat market in Reading grow next year?
Are new builds in Coventry selling at a premium?

title: US Airline On-Time Performance & Delay Causes
description: Monthly arrivals, delays, cancellations and diversions for every major US carrier at every airport, with delay minutes split by cause: carrier, weather, air traffic system, security and late-arriving aircraft.
grain: one row per carrier per airport per month
notes: CSV with a header. year, month (1-12), carrier (code, e.g. DL) and carrier_name, airport (code, e.g. JFK, ORD, ATL) and airport_name. arr_flights = arriving flights; arr_del15 = arrivals 15+ minutes late; arr_cancelled, arr_diverted = counts. *_ct columns (carrier_ct, weather_ct, nas_ct, security_ct, late_aircraft_ct) = delayed flights attributed to each cause (fractional). arr_delay = total delay minutes, split into carrier_delay, weather_delay, nas_delay (air traffic system), security_delay, late_aircraft_delay. Delay rate = arr_del15 / arr_flights. Small enough to load whole (no filter needed).
examples: Which US airlines had the worst delays in 2025?
What causes most flight delays at Chicago O'Hare?
Will delays at JFK get worse next year?
